channel.title: GetMyYes Health Insurance Appeal Guides
channel.description: Plain-English health insurance appeal guides and free letter templates.

item.title: Appeal a Health Denial in California (DMHC IMR)
item.description: How to appeal a California health insurance denial: which regulator covers your plan, the free DMHC Independent Medical Review process, deadlines, and a request template.

item.title: Therapy Denied? Use Parity Rules to Appeal
item.description: Federal parity law bars stricter limits on mental health and substance-use care than medical care. Learn how to use it in your appeal, plus a free letter template.

item.title: Appeal an Emergency-Room Claim Denial | GetMyYes
item.description: Learn how the prudent-layperson standard can apply to an emergency-room denial, what evidence to collect, and how to use a free appeal letter template.

item.title: Appeal a “Not Medically Necessary” Denial | GetMyYes
item.description: Learn how to request the plan criteria and clinical rationale behind a medical-necessity denial, organize evidence, and use a free appeal template.

item.title: Appeal a Formulary Exclusion | GetMyYes
item.description: Medication not on your insurance formulary? How to request a formulary exception with your prescriber, appeal a denial, and a free exception letter template.

item.title: Appeal a Prior Authorization Denial | GetMyYes
item.description: Prior authorization denied by your insurance? How to appeal a prior auth denial, when to demand a 72-hour expedited review, and a free appeal letter template.

item.title: Appeal a Step Therapy Denial | GetMyYes
item.description: Learn how treatment history can support a step-therapy exception, what your clinician should address, and how to use the free appeal template.

item.title: Free Health Insurance Appeal Letter Template | GetMyYes
item.description: Free appeal letter template for health insurance denials — copy, paste, and fill in. Includes line-by-line instructions, an urgent/expedited version, and what to attach.

item.title: How to Appeal a Health Insurance Denial | GetMyYes
item.description: A step-by-step guide to internal appeals and external review, including deadlines, supporting documents, submission records, and a free letter template.

item.title: Appeal an Experimental-Treatment Denial | GetMyYes
item.description: How to appeal an experimental or investigational treatment denial, obtain the insurer's clinical rationale, organize medical evidence, and request external review.

item.title: External Review: Steps and Deadlines | GetMyYes
item.description: How external review works after a health-insurance denial: eligibility, filing deadlines, standard and urgent timelines, and a free request template.

item.title: Out-of-Network Claim Denied? How to Appeal
item.description: How to appeal an out-of-network health insurance denial, check No Surprises Act protections, document a network-directory error, and use a free letter template.
